script.speaker: liam
script.text: everyone drop everything. the noodle stall, the one nobody could find all summer: my cousin's roommate works the market and she swears it's on the noodle row

script.speaker: liam
script.text: which cart, she wouldn't say. just 'you'll know at the first slurp'

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: finally!! you've talked about this stall all summer. i am not missing the ending

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: noodle row?? i'm down. i'll check every cart myself if i have to

script.speaker: maya
script.text: i'm in, but the trip fund has me on a coin purse tonight. coins only. no paper money leaves my wallet

script.speaker: liam
script.text: how far do coins go on noodle row

script.speaker: maya
script.text: exactly as far as the cheapest bowls. if the price board makes me break a bill, i will be very dramatic about it

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Count me in. Same routine as any new stall: I ask the cook one question before anyone orders.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: the question. ever since the satay incident i could ask it in my sleep

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: adding it to my cart checklist then. any peanut, any form, in the wok or on top, we walk

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: my grandma lands tomorrow and her first question is always "are you eating your greens?" i want to say yes and mean it

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: a bowl that's actually green and doesn't leave me feeling like a fried dumpling. my body is begging

script.speaker: liam
script.text: oh and roxy, milkshake incident rules: my tipster says a lot of carts on that row finish the broth with butter or a splash of milk

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ...you remembered the milkshake?? ok yeah. no butter, no milk, nothing creamy in mine

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Assistant, the row is long and Liam's tip ends there. Over to you.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: one slurp. that's all i need
